Subject: Your geographical-indication dispute matter - CS(COMM) 1863/2025

Dear Ms. Subramanian,

Thank you for meeting us on 26 February 2025 about your dispute with Trident Exports. As we understand it, a conflicting trademark was registered.

Our advice is to file a rectification petition against the conflicting trademark. Please collect the trademark registration and the GI registration and send copies to this office. We will pursue the full claim of ₹7,40,00,000.

Regards,
Adv. Sharmila Venkatesan
